name: Insieme
source:
Mika, an orphan surviving in a poor area, supports herself by gathering information for the mafia. 
Her routine is disrupted when she narrowly dodges a kidnapping attempt by a mysterious figure in black. A stranger steps in, saving her. Grateful for his help but suspicious of his motives, Mika decides to stick with him, eager to uncover his secrets.

"If you're determined to come along, I guess I should at least tell you my name."
"I'm Rad. Nice to meet you, young lady."

[Roughly translated from [url=https://insiegame.jimdofree.com/story/]official website.[/url]]
translation:
米卡是一名生活在贫困地区的孤儿，她靠为黑手党收集信息养活自己。
当她险些躲过一名神秘黑衣人的绑架企图时，她的日常生活被打乱了。一个陌生人介入，救了她。米卡感谢他的帮助，但又怀疑他的动机，决定留在他身边，渴望揭开他的秘密。

“如果你决定一起去的话，我想我至少应该告诉你我的名字。”
“我是拉德。很高兴认识你，年轻的女士。”

[大致翻译自[url=https://insiegame.jimdofree.com/story/]官网[/url]]
